text:
Ivy: Heads up  visiting Portland office next Wed. Anyone have recs around the South Waterfront food cart pod? Looking for casual, good veg/vegan options, group of 5, ~6:30pm.
Marco: If you like Thai-ish bowls, Lotus Cart (yellow truck) has killer tofu bowls and big portions.
Sophie: Love Lotus  also the empanada truck (La Cumbia) does a great vegan black bean empanada.
Raj: There's a wood-fired pizza trailer that shows up on Wed nights  thin crust, can do GF and veg toppings. Name's EmberSlice.
Hannah: Heads up: some carts close early if it rains. Pod usually has covered seating but bring a light jacket.
Omar: Poll: react :one: Lotus bowls  :two: La Cumbia empanadas  :three: EmberSlice pizza  :four: Walk to nearby restaurant (if weather bad)
Sophie: :one:
Marco: :one: :thumbsup:
Raj: :three: (pizza!!)
Ivy: Leaning Lotus or pizza. Anyone want to call EmberSlice to check if theyll be there Wed and do GF crust?
Ben: I'll ping EmberSlice Instagram DM and call Lotus to confirm tofu availability for bulk order.
Ben: Lotus confirms they can do a plated order for 5 with tofu bowls and one gluten-free bowl. Conf ID LT-452. They can put trays by 6:20pm.
Ben: EmberSlice replied on IG: likely there Wed, GF crust yes but limited stock  suggests ordering by 5pm.
Sophie: OK fallback plan: Lotus primary, EmberSlice if GF pizza desired. Want me to place Lotus order and pick up?
Ivy: That'd be amazing, Sophie. Also one person is pescatarian. Lotus tofu bowls can be swapped for a grilled salmon add-on apparently.
Sophie: Placing order now: 4 tofu bowls, 1 salmon bowl, 1 GF tofu bowl, sides of kimchi + roasted sweet potato. ETA trays by 6:20pm. Order Conf: LT-PDX-773.
Ivy: Added to calendar.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar "Wed PDX: Food cart pod - Lotus + EmberSlice fallback (6:30pm)".
street-food-bot: Tip: South Waterfront pod has 2 picnic tables under awning and free street parking after 7pm on nearby side streets.
Marco: Thanks y'all  see you Wednesday, I'll bring napkins and wet wipes.
Raj: If anyone wants pizza instead DM me and I'll place EmberSlice pre-order by 5pm.
Hannah: Bringing a raincoat just in case. :umbrella:
Ivy: Perfect. Appreciate the speedy help!
